audit_items.proof_trace: Every borrow flows through the single `handle_borrow` caller (market.move:412-413), which calls `try_borrow_asset` then unconditionally calls `enforce_post_borrow_repay_invariant` with the coin-specific minimum. After `try_borrow_asset`, a debt entry always exists (created or incremented), so `has_debt` never short-circuits and the assert is always evaluated. Interest is pre-accrued at line 407, so `unsafe_debt_amount()` is current; any borrow resulting in debt below `min_borrow_amount` aborts the transaction.
